selections.rationale: Normalize the outer document Mapping to dict then deepcopy its contents; preserve all original Outcome, activation, history, first-failure and ownership behavior. No promise for noncopyable nested objects.
Normalize cache Mapping to a detached mutable dict before copying; preserve first-script selection, HTML tolerance, URL and filename-cache rules. Available remains read-only; no real networking.
Prevent used+seats overflow by checking seats against capacity-used before addition. Preserve valid MaxInt capacity, validation/error atomicity, cancellation, IDs and ordered detached snapshots.

Use lazy packet storage rather than allocating logical capacity at construction; valid MaxInt capacity with few packets must work. Preserve mutex safety, validation precedence, global/topic drain order, byte ownership and non-nil empties.

Explicitly materialize validated required key/code/owner/openedOn fields on constructor/add/edit copies, including directly readable non-enumerable or inherited fields. Preserve no-op identity, changed-record sharing and search references; no universal deep-copy requirement.

Copy all own byId dictionary keys including non-enumerable names into null-prototype output while retaining unaffected record identities. Materialize affected required fields explicitly. Preserve ordered IDs, no-op identity, pin order sharing and atomic replace; support __proto__ as data.

Apply supported patch fields by direct reads, including non-enumerable values; retain ID. Explicit derived rule: absent or undefined optional patch values leave that field unchanged; supplied other invalid values reject atomically; extra id cannot replace reservation ID. Preserve foreign keys, collision handling, order and detached observations.

Select displayName/active directly including hidden false. Explicit derived rule: absent or undefined optional patch fields leave values unchanged, while other invalid supplied values reject without mutation. Preserve empty-patch notifications, detached account/listener copies, independent duplicate subscriptions and snapshot dispatch.

Keep original u32 bonus_damage.saturating_mul(charge_ms) then division then saturating base addition; do not widen multiplication. Original oracle conflicts with that formula and remains archived, not reused. Preserve charged-action energy, swing/recovery progression, one strike, zero durations and interruption. No unrelated specification changes.

Explicitly reserve balance plus pending withdrawal amount within u64: record rejects Overflow atomically if its charge violates this combined invariant. A valid failed withdrawal always restores amount and clears pending. Preserve getter balance meaning, authorization, pause, overrides, successful completion and atomic error behavior.

Use exact safe decomposition or BigInteger intermediates for half-up basis-point components, rejecting only genuinely unrepresentable required monetary results/final totals. Preserve original rounding/order and deterministic participant-share distribution; no huge allocation needed.

Explicit derived rules: retain String.trim output normalization but reject leaf values blank by String.isBlank/Character.isWhitespace; comments are ignored and cannot satisfy required structural children. Preserve direct-child schema, ordered duplicate messages, detached immutability, numeric validation and DOCTYPE/external-entity rejection.
